_comment: A combination aura that both damages and slows the nearest enemy in a 1-unit ring every 40 ticks: 6.5 HP plus 3.375 per level of frost damage, plus a slow of 10 percent plus 10 per level. Only the damage effect carries a cost, since both effects fire off the same 40-tick cadence and the costed one is authored first. An unlisted combo recipe. All values placeholder.
name: Hoarfrost
